jd_file: Cluster Director of IT - Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong
role_summary: Oversees IT operations, cybersecurity, and digital infrastructure for two flagship properties, driving technology strategy and guest-facing digital innovation while managing budgets, compliance, and team leadership.
must_have_requirements: Minimum 5 years of senior IT management experience within luxury hospitality
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or equivalent
Proven proficiency in hotel-specific systems (PMS, POS, CRM)
Significant experience in budget management and CapEx planning
Strong technical background in network infrastructure and Wi-Fi performance
Demonstrable track record in cybersecurity strategy and PCI compliance
Advanced vendor management and contract negotiation experience
nice_to_have_requirements: Digital transformation project leadership in F&B or large-scale event spaces
Expertise in Audio Visual (AV) systems management for luxury events

scoring_criteria.name: Luxury Hospitality IT Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires navigation of the specific high-standard expectations of the luxury hotel sector.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from non-hospitality sectors require deep enterprise-scale infrastructure experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Technical Proficiency (PMS/POS/Network)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Daily operations rely on stable core hospitality systems and robust network infrastructure.

scoring_criteria.name: Cybersecurity & PCI Compliance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Mandarin Oriental is a high-profile target; maintaining data integrity and compliance is non-negotiable.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Budget & Project Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Responsible for life-cycle management and 5-year capital planning.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Vendor Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Success depends on influencing GMs and managing high-value external partners.

scoring_criteria.name: Team Leadership & Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Needs to build and nurture a high-performing service-focused technical team.

scoring_criteria.name: Digital Transformation & Innovation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The group values cutting-edge innovation for guest experiences.

scoring_criteria.name: Audio Visual Support Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for high-end events and hotel operations performance.

summary_focus: High-end hospitality IT background, technical strategic oversight, and commitment to service excellence.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming 'software engineering' skills; focus on 'system integration' and 'operations management' instead.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize your role as a 'business partner' to hotel GMs, not just a technician.
bridge_gaps_honestly: Focus on transferable technical governance skills if moving from a high-security industry like Finance or Banking into Luxury Hotels.
